## Reconcile Vendor Statements

### Scope

Monthly agreement of supplier statements to the paid and open items in the
ledger, and the pursuit of the differences. A single L3 — the node slug is
the step slug.

The node sits after disbursement and feeds nothing else in this area: its
product is evidence, filed and retained. Aged-item write-off and vendor
credit application are adjacent activities the client performs in the close,
outside this area's boundary.

```consult-meta
systems:
  - netsuite
  - excel
  - finance-shared-drive
roles:
  - ap-manager
  - corporate-controller
  - supplier
```
